title: CircleCI docs page metadata
description: The AsciiDoc page-* attributes CircleCI docs pages carry, per DOC-269. Comma-separated fields (page-content-type, page-vcs) are typed as strings with a pattern, not arrays, because AsciiDoc attribute values are text — see docs/contributors for authoring guidance.

page-description.description: Populates the HTML <meta> description tag. Required on every page.

page-content-type.description: Diataxis content type(s), comma-separated. Multiple values are a permanent valid state for mixed pages, not a debt marker.

page-platform.description: Comma-separated cloud/server enum. Migrated from the old mixed version+audience values (e.g. 'Server 4.9, Server Admin') on 2026-09-24; version moved to page-server-min-version, audience to page-audience. Required on every page, per the house style guide.

page-server-min-version.description: Minimum Server version a feature is available from, e.g. '4.7'. Only meaningful when page-platform includes Server.

page-server-deprecated-in.description: Server version a feature was deprecated/removed in, e.g. '5.0'. Only meaningful when page-platform includes Server.

page-vcs.description: VCS provider(s) a feature is available for, comma-separated. 'all' must not be combined with specific providers (enforced by review, not this schema).

page-badge.description: Feature lifecycle badge shown under the page title. 'New' is deliberately excluded — it goes stale.

page-audience.description: Replaces the old 'Server Admin' marker baked into page-platform. 'admin' where that marker was present, 'developer' as the default everywhere else.
